criteria.criterion: Use Google Flights to run the specified search (route, dates, passengers, cabin) or clearly report access issues
criteria.final_justification: The DOM explicitly supports that the agent ran the specified search with correct route, dates, cabin (Economy), and passenger count (1). No access issues/blockers are evidenced. Baseline score remains fully supported.

criteria.criterion: Apply the nonstop filter (direct flights only) or clearly report inability to do so
criteria.final_justification: Nonstop filtering is explicitly evidenced as selected in the latest DOM, and the visible flights are labeled nonstop. Full credit is warranted; no adjustment needed.

criteria.criterion: Identify and compare the lowest-priced visible nonstop options (up to three) given available results
criteria.final_justification: The agent selected and compared the three lowest visible nonstop options (a three-way tie at €154). Even though they are all the same airline, they are still the three lowest visible options, so the criterion is satisfied as stated. Baseline score stands.

criteria.criterion: Report required details for each compared option (airline, departure time, duration, round-trip fare) or clearly note missing fields
criteria.final_justification: For each compared option, the agent reported airline, outbound departure/arrival times, duration, and round-trip fare—these are supported by the DOM. However, the agent did not provide return-leg departure times/duration, and while the agent notes Google Flights is “only showing the outbound leg details,” the task requirement is still to report departure time(s) (outbound and return, or clearly note missing). Since return times are not provided, only partial credit is appropriate (not a contradiction, but an omission of required schedule detail).

criteria.criterion: Recommend the best balance of price and schedule (no booking)
criteria.final_justification: The recommendation (8:45 PM departure as best balance) is consistent with the DOM evidence given identical fares/durations and more practical timing than 3:00 AM or after-midnight arrival. The agent did not book. Even though the return-leg schedule isn’t visible, a schedule-based recommendation among these three using outbound timing is still grounded in what’s shown, and the agent acknowledged limited visibility. Full credit is appropriate.
